measure_description: Measured manually with a Shelly Plus Plug UK on the dock's mains lead (UK, 232-242 V), so every figure covers the whole RockDock Ultra plus robot, polling the plug's Switch.GetStatus apower every 2 s and joining it to the Home Assistant roborock integration's battery and status history. Charging: one continuous charge from 25 % to 100 % with mop drying switched OFF, averaged per reported battery percent (29-67 samples per step, sd under 0.2 W). The robot's gauge rescales near the top: real charging ends around a reported 92 %, after which the dock holds 2.77 W while the percentage climbs to 100 %, so 93-100 % is the docked-and-full draw. The first minutes after docking show a 9.6 W pause before charging ramps up; that is not modelled. Below 26 % the curve holds its first point (the only sub-26 % charge overlapped drying). Emptying the bin: two 32 s cycles, energy-averaged 947 and 864 W (peak 1188 W). Mop washing: five cycles of 131-157 s, 10.0-10.7 W. Robot away from the dock: 0.35 W (standby_power). NOT MODELLED, because the status sensor keeps reading 'charging' throughout: warm-air mop drying after a mop run. With drying on, a charge from 19 % averaged 88.5 W instead of ~29 W: an ~8 W fan plus a ~76 W heater on about 65 % of the time (113 W on / 37 W off). Users with drying enabled will see this profile under-read by roughly 55-60 W for the configured drying time.
name: S7 Max Ultra
